name: pitmaster
description: Skills for running work with your agent: grill the plan before it starts (bbq), record decisions as ADRs (makeadr), find what is holding a comrun back (swarm-bottleneck), pick its budget (budget-select) and models (tier-select), record what it spent beside what it landed (spend-ledger), let the agent pick the work (dealers-choice) and give it standing authority for a session (carte-blanche), set a project up for agents (project-prep), talk a subject through, then write one record of what was said (talk-through), have several agents argue a decision out while the lead judges (townhall), audit blind whether a repo or an app is ready for its end users (tastetest), carry a settled plan on into the build, stopping at "ratify" (goforit), find what was left unfinished and offer to tie it off (looseends), check what limits each neighbour model and whether it is busy (neighbour-check), and run release day, approving each public copy on the way out (setfree).

interface.shortDescription: Grill the plan, record the decision, find the bottleneck, pick the budget and the models.
